objective: Ablate the exact-current WP507 matched-probe baseline against two thin execution-context binding placements under equivalent deterministic cases: A) direct opaque context digest on each arm; B) typed ProbeExecutionContext canonical object whose digest each arm must consume. Compare confound rejection, fail-closed semantics, serialized overhead, hash/check count, duplication/drift risk and source integration surface.
acceptance: Candidate must reject distinct execution contexts, preserve the matched baseline when contexts are equal, require no model/provider/runtime dependency, and have a clear fail-closed identity semantics. Prefer the smallest candidate that does not reduce the context digest to an unverifiable caller convention.
explicit_nonclaims: No accepted WP507 source is mutated by this research ablation.
Local deterministic timing/size measurements are research-surface measurements, not F2 target-runtime benchmarks.
E4 success does not grant E5 build-candidate, E6 acceptance, GWT runtime, J-Space or whole-system credit.
